reason_for_followup: The prespecified reset distribution improved middle-price losses but had worse range coverage and failed promotion. This follow-up tests that specific diagnosed failure; it was designed after seeing the first experiment and is not an independent confirmation on the old dates.
rule: Use the frozen price-reset model's q50. Retain q10 and q90 from the existing selected calibration method. If necessary only, expand q10 downward or q90 upward to contain the new q50. Enforce q10 >= 1e-9. No parameters are tuned and no probability averaging is introduced.
additional_check_status: Previously unscored November backtests, not truly unseen data: the source prices were already available in the pack and November6prices were used as economic anchors. No 7-day November result can be scored before the pack ends.
additional_selected_comparator: At each additional origin generate official drift and apply the existing frozen calibration function using only the original14origin forecast residual archive with target dates strictly before that origin. No additional-origin outcomes enter that residual archive.
scoring: Unmodified Pacific scorer, identical scored cells and declared origins/horizons. Pair origin bootstrap5000 seed20261115 on old primary dates; no significance claim from the three additional dates.
promotion_gates_all_required: Old primary pooled error lower than both comparators with paired95% improvement intervals entirely above zero
Old primary mean-series skill versus Pacific at least zero and no worse than selected
Old primary coverage no farther from80% than selected
Additional November pooled error lower than both comparators and mean-series skill versusPacific no worse than selected
All quantile validity and strict temporal leakage checks pass
All existing forecast files remain unchanged
new_file: Only if every gate passes, save forecasts_reset_median.csv separately. Never overwrite existing forecasts or silently change the selected submission.
falsification: If the previously unscored dates reverse the apparent gain, reject promotion even if the old dates look better. Report this negative result.
